data.narrative:
Allen Control Systems, a Series B defense and security company founded by Mike Wior, Steve Simoni, and Luke Allen, has raised $200M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers spanning the Defense & Security sector—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base of $200M and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yields $380M. Peer-median analysis across 7 same-stage, same-sector comparables produces a $1.0B midpoint valuation, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The peer set reflects material dispersion: Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and two peers anchoring the median at $1.0B each.

The combined analysis supports a valuation range of $323M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $690M. Stage-progression implies conservative positioning relative to peer medians, suggesting either differentiated risk factors or earlier-stage revenue maturity relative to the peer cohort. Key uncertainties include whether Allen Control's revenue profile and growth trajectory align with the upper or lower quartile of the peer set, and the degree to which public-market comparables (currently limited to 2 names) would narrow this range with additional disclosure.
